purpose: Compress one verified shared-current rehydration transition into the minimum causally sufficient context a successor agent must hydrate.

semantic_boundary.routing_successor: WHAT NEXT should be attempted; owned by ATHENA.REHYDRATION.SUCCESSOR.BATON.V1
semantic_boundary.handoff_delta: WHAT STATE the successor must rehydrate before acting

source_of_truth: ATHENA.REHYDRATION.LOOP.V1 state, prompt and receipt hash chain after the selected shared-read freshness membrane
persistence_law: handoff delta is a deterministic projection and creates no Git commit

read_freshness.REQUIRED: sync shared Git before chain verification; unverified shared frontier yields HANDOFF_SHARED_FRONTIER_HOLD
read_freshness.BEST_EFFORT: sync before verification but preserve explicit HANDOFF_READY_UNVERIFIED when a shared witness is unavailable
read_freshness.DISABLED: perform local/offline derivation without claiming shared-current freshness
read_freshness.consume_race_closure: repeat shared-fresh derivation immediately before local cone consumption and hold if the digest or exact-tip state changed

transition.bound_routing_context: completion.successor_baton is surfaced as routing_successor and remains receipt-bound; the handoff layer never re-scores it

hydration_modes.DELTA_ONLY: prompt and frontier content identities are unchanged; consume receipt/work/residual cone only
hydration_modes.PROMPT_CONE: prompt-stack identity changed; expand current prompt-policy cone plus work delta
hydration_modes.FRONTIER_CONE: frontier identity changed; expand current frontier cone plus work delta
hydration_modes.PROMPT_AND_FRONTIER_CONE: both content identities changed; expand both cones
hydration_modes.FULL_REHYDRATE_REQUIRED: required predecessor/current coordinate coverage is absent
hydration_modes.HEAD_MOVED_REHYDRATE_REQUIRED: handoff identity remains stable but observer is no longer at the exact loop checkpoint

identity_law.handoff_digest: SHA-256 identity inherited from the verified transition projection
identity_law.reason: freshness may invalidate consumption but cannot rewrite the identity of a completed predecessor transition

coverage.consequence: refresh frontier interpretation/witness before consequential scheduler action

optimization_goal: reduce handoff context cost while preserving shared-current causal continuity and fail-closed freshness
